text:
maya: quick summary from the deepbench bring-up of atlas13b-int5 (focus: mixed chat + tabular extraction). posting cost/quality snapshot and routing suggestion.

leo: paste the numbers please.

maya: fp16 p50 90ms, unit ~$124/1M. int6 p50 72ms ~$54/1M. int5 p50 66ms ~$46/1M. per-channel int4 p50 60ms ~$38/1M.

zane: quality deltas?

maya: short-chat RL delta: int5 -0.9, int4 -1.9. tabular-extract EM: int5 -1.6, int4 -3.4. citation-preserve RL: int5 -1.8, int4 -3.9. weighted human_accept ~ -1.5pts for int5, -3.0pts int4.

rachel: product asks for a low-cost default but zero surprises on tables/citations. routing rec?

maya: recommend default -> int5. Predicates to route to int6/fp16: (1) table markers or CSV-like tokens, (2) presence of URLs/citation tokens, (3) token_count>320, (4) user_tier enterprise. Also add a cheap classifier (embed->sigmoid) for borderline cases.

leo: ops checklist?

canary-bot: rollout items created: add config quant.default=atlas-int5; add metric quant_fallback_rate; shadow int6 3% traffic 24h; canary 2% for 72h; alert if fallback_rate>8% or complaint spike.

zane: small scorecard (mock):
```
slice: short-chat         | FP16 RL 45.0 | INT5 RL 44.1 | delta -0.9 | cost ratio 0.37
slice: table-extract     | FP16 EM 89.2 | INT5 EM 87.6 | delta -1.6 | cost ratio 0.37
slice: citation-preserve | FP16 RL 50.0 | INT5 RL 48.2 | delta -1.8 | cost ratio 0.37
unit_cost_per_1M: FP16 $124 | INT6 $54 | INT5 $46 | PC-INT4 $38
```

rachel: ML asks: run a 36h per-layer sweep (attention vs ff quant) focused on table/citation slices and a 200-case human eval for citation preservation.

maya: will schedule sweep (2xA100-80GB) and push a scorecard update.

leo: GTN blurb draft: "Atlas13b-int5 delivers a cost-performance middle ground for chat workloads; automated fidelity rails ensure tables and citation-heavy prompts are handled at higher precision when accuracy matters."

rachel: lean default int5 + predicates. I'll own the 200-case eval.

canary-bot: reminder scheduled for canary review in 72h.

maya: thanks team 44d will post sweep stub & results here when ready.
